import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load datasets
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_test_2.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_sample_submission_2.csv")

# Ensure consistent string formatting across all dataframes
for col in ["before", "after"]:
    if col in train_df.columns:
        train_df[col] = train_df[col].astype(str).str.strip()
    if col in test_df.columns:
        test_df[col] = test_df[col].astype(str).str.strip()

# Strict sentence-level holdout to eliminate data leakage
all_sentence_ids = train_df["sentence_id"].unique()
train_sids, val_sids = train_test_split(
    all_sentence_ids, test_size=0.1, random_state=42, shuffle=True
)

train_fold = train_df[train_df["sentence_id"].isin(train_sids)].copy()
val_fold = train_df[train_df["sentence_id"].isin(val_sids)].copy()

# Build frequency-based lookup EXCLUSIVELY on the training fold
pair_counts = train_fold.groupby(["before", "after"]).size().reset_index(name="freq")
best_pairs = pair_counts.loc[pair_counts.groupby("before")["freq"].idxmax()]
lookup_dict = dict(zip(best_pairs["before"], best_pairs["after"]))

# Evaluate on the untouched validation fold (model never saw these rows)
val_pred = val_fold["before"].map(lookup_dict).fillna(val_fold["before"])
val_accuracy = (val_fold["after"] == val_pred).mean()
print(f"Hold-out Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.6f}")

# Final submission preparation: refit on FULL training data for maximum coverage
full_pair_counts = train_df.groupby(["before", "after"]).size().reset_index(name="freq")
full_best = full_pair_counts.loc[full_pair_counts.groupby("before")["freq"].idxmax()]
final_lookup = dict(zip(full_best["before"], full_best["after"]))

test_pred = test_df["before"].map(final_lookup).fillna(test_df["before"])

# Align predictions with the exact sample submission structure
submission = sample_sub.copy()
submission["after"] = test_pred.values

# Save to required path
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission successfully saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
